questions.stem: Which of the following immunopathogenetic mechanisms is primarily responsible for Type II Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT)?

options.text: Formation of IgG autoantibodies against Platelet Factor 4 (PF4)-heparin complexes that cross-link FcγRIIa receptors on platelets.
IgA immune complex deposition on vascular endothelial cells leading to IgA vasculitis.
Direct non-immune osmotic lysis of platelets caused by hyperosmolar heparin preparations.
IgM complement activation causing membrane attack complex insertion into megakaryocytes.

questions.sourceExplanation: Type II Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT) 屬於免疫介導的重症病變。當 Unfractionated Heparin (UFH) 或 Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin (LMWH) 與 Platelet 顆粒中釋放的 Platelet Factor 4 (PF4) 結合形成超大 Tetramer Complex 時，會誘發產生對抗 PF4-Heparin Complex 的 IgG Autoantibodies。此 Immune Complex 透過與 Platelet 膜上的 FcγRIIa Receptor 跨聯 (Cross-linking)，傳遞強烈的 Platelet Activation 信號，導致 Platelet Microparticles 釋放、Thrombin 大量生成與全血管床血栓形成。

questions.stem: A 62-year-old male on unfractionated heparin (UFH) for deep vein thrombosis (DVT) shows a platelet count drop from 240,000/μL to 90,000/μL on Day 7 of therapy. He is clinically stable without bleeding. What is the most appropriate initial step in management?

options.text: Transfuse 2 units of platelets and continue unfractionated heparin while awaiting anti-PF4 ELISA results.
Discontinue unfractionated heparin immediately and initiate a non-heparin anticoagulant such as Argatroban.
Switch unfractionated heparin to therapeutic-dose Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin (LMWH).
Immediately start oral Warfarin monotherapy and monitor INR daily.

questions.sourceExplanation: 患者在接受 Unfractionated Heparin (UFH) 治療第 7 天出現 Platelet 下降超過 50%（由 240,000 降至 90,000/μL），4Ts Score 屬於 High Risk。臨床上對於中高風險 HIT 患者，首要處置為**立即停用所有 Heparin 產品**，並啟動非肝素抗凝血劑（如 Argatroban 或 Bivalirudin）進行 Therapeutic Anticoagulation。切換為 Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin (LMWH) 會因 >90% 的 Cross-Reactivity 而惡化血栓；輸注 Platelet 或單獨使用 Warfarin 均為嚴禁處置。

questions.stem: In calculating the 4Ts pretest probability score for suspected Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT), which clinical scenario receives the maximum score of 2 points for the 'Timing' category?

options.text: Platelet count fall occurring after Day 14 of heparin exposure without prior heparin history.
Platelet count fall occurring on Day 2 of heparin exposure in a patient with no heparin exposure in the past year.
Platelet count fall occurring between Day 5 and Day 10 of heparin exposure, or within 24 hours if heparin was administered within the past 100 days.
Platelet count fall occurring immediately post-operatively prior to heparin administration.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 4Ts Score 評分系統中，Timing 項目的最高分 (2 分) 標準為：(1) 在首次暴露 Heparin 後的第 5 至 10 天之間發生 Platelet 下降；或者 (2) 患者在過去 100 天內曾接受過 Heparin 暴露，本次暴露後在 24 小時內發生 Rapid-onset Platelet 下降（因為體內殘存對抗 PF4-Heparin 的 IgG 記憶抗體）。

questions.stem: Which laboratory assay is considered the gold standard functional test with high specificity (>95%) for confirming Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT)?

options.text: Anti-PF4/Heparin ELISA Immunoassay.
Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT).
Prothrombin Time / International Normalized Ratio (PT/INR).
Serotonin Release Assay (SRA).

questions.sourceExplanation: Serotonin Release Assay (SRA) 是診斷 HIT 的黃金標準功能性檢驗 (Gold Standard Functional Assay)。SRA 利用經 14C-Serotonin 標記的 Donor Platelets，加入患者血清與低/高濃度 Heparin，量測 Platelet 釋放 Serotonin 的比例，具有 >95% 的極高 Sensitivity 與 Specificity。相對地，Anti-PF4 ELISA 為敏感度高但特異度較低的 Screening Assay。

questions.stem: Why is Warfarin monotherapy strictly contraindicated during the acute phase of Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT) when platelets are severely depressed?

options.text: Warfarin rapidly depletes Protein C prior to prothrombin clearance, predisposing to microvascular thrombosis and venous limb gangrene.
Warfarin directly activates platelet FcγRIIa receptors and worsens thrombocytopenia.
Warfarin neutralizes Argatroban clearance and causes acute liver toxicity.
Warfarin induces severe hyperkalemia by inhibiting adrenal 18-hydroxylase.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 HIT 急性期（Platelet 顯著降低時），絕對禁止單獨啟動 Warfarin 治療。因為 Warfarin 會優先抑制半衰期極短的天然抗凝血因子 Protein C (t1/2 ~6 小時)，而 Prothrombin (Factor II) 的半衰期較長 (t1/2 ~60 小時)。這會導致體內天然抗凝血能力驟降，在 HIT 原本高 Thrombin 的背景下惡化微血管血栓，引發 Microvascular Thrombosis, Skin Necrosis 以及 Venous Limb Gangrene。

questions.stem: A 58-year-old female with End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) on maintenance hemodialysis develops suspected Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT). Which non-heparin direct thrombin inhibitor is preferred because its elimination is independent of renal clearance?

options.text: Fondaparinux.
Argatroban.
Enoxaparin.
Dabigatran.

questions.sourceExplanation: Argatroban 是一種小分子的 Direct Thrombin Inhibitor (DTI)，其清除完全依賴肝臟代謝與膽汁排泄 (Hepatic Metabolism)，其 Elimination Half-life (~45 min) 在 End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) 或 Hemodialysis 患者體內完全不受影響。因此 Argatroban 是腎功能衰竭與透析患者發生 HIT 時的首選抗凝血劑。相較之下，Fondaparinux 與 Dabigatran 依賴腎臟排泄，在 ESRD 會嚴重蓄積。

resolvedImages.caption: Brenner 11e Table 63.8: Guidelines for Anticoagulation in Hemodialysis Patients at High Risk for Serious Bleeding.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements regarding the laboratory screening assay (Anti-PF4/Heparin ELISA) for HIT is correct?

options.text: It has a 100% specificity for clinical HIT, meaning all positive ELISA tests indicate active HIT thrombosis.
It measures functional serotonin release from washed donor platelets.
It has a very high sensitivity (>99%), so a negative result strongly excludes HIT (high negative predictive value).
It cannot detect IgG class antibodies against PF4-heparin complexes.

questions.sourceExplanation: Anti-PF4/Heparin ELISA Immunoassay 具有極高的 Sensitivity (>99%)，其 Negative Predictive Value (NPV) 近乎 100%，因此陰性結果可以非常可靠地排除 HIT。然而其 Specificity 較低 (70–85%)，因為許多暴露過 Heparin 的心臟手術或透析患者體內會產生無致病功能的 Non-platelet-activating Anti-PF4 Antibodies，陽性結果需結合 4Ts Score 與 SRA 功能性分析進行綜合研判。

resolvedImages.caption: Brenner 11e Table 63.8: Guidelines for Anticoagulation in Hemodialysis Patients at High Risk for Serious Bleeding.

questions.stem: A patient with confirmed HIT is being treated with continuous Argatroban infusion. The patient's platelet count recovers to 180,000/μL, and Warfarin is overlapping. How should Argatroban be safely discontinued during Warfarin transition?

options.text: Stop Argatroban immediately as soon as Warfarin is prescribed.
Stop Argatroban when the combined INR reaches 2.0.
Administer Vitamin K1 to reverse Argatroban before stopping.
Continue Argatroban co-administration for at least 5 days until the combined INR is >4.0, then stop Argatroban and recheck INR in 4-6 hours.

questions.sourceExplanation: Argatroban 會顯著干擾 PT/INR 測量，使 INR 額外升高。當 Argatroban 與 Warfarin 重疊使用時，必須重疊至少 5 天且 Platelet 回升至 >150,000/μL。由於 Argatroban 造成的附加 INR 提升，兩藥併用時的目標 INR 通常需要達到 >4.0；在停用 Argatroban 4–6 小時後（待 Argatroban 完全清除），單獨測量 Warfarin 的真實 INR 仍達 2.0–3.0 方可完全停用 Argatroban。

questions.stem: Why are platelet transfusions generally contraindicated in patients with acute Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia (HIT) unless life-threatening hemorrhage occurs?

options.text: Infused platelets provide additional substrate for anti-PF4/heparin antibodies, triggering further activation and thrombotic events.
Transfused platelets rapidly clear Argatroban from the bloodstream.
Transfused platelets cause acute intravascular hemolysis via complement activation.
Transfused platelets induce severe metabolic alkalosis via citrate load.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 HIT 急性期，患者循環中存在高濃度的 Anti-PF4/Heparin Immune Complexes。此時若輸注外源性 Platelets，輸入的血小板會提供大量的 PF4 與 FcγRIIa Receptor，如同「加油添火 (Fueling the fire)」，引發更為劇烈的 Platelet Activation 與 Thrombin 暴衝，進而誘發致命的 Arterial and Venous Thrombosis。因此除危及生命的出血外，HIT 嚴禁預防性輸注 Platelets。

questions.stem: A 65-year-old male undergoing urgent Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) has a documented history of acute HIT 2 weeks ago with persistent SRA positivity. Which short-acting intravenous direct thrombin inhibitor is preferred for anticoagulation during PCI?

options.text: Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin.
Bivalirudin.
Warfarin.
Rivaroxaban.

questions.sourceExplanation: Bivalirudin 是一種短效的 IV Direct Thrombin Inhibitor (DTI)，半衰期約 25 分鐘，主要經由血漿蛋白酶水解 (80%) 與腎臟清除 (20%)。在心導管 Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) 或心臟手術中，對於近代 (90天內) 曾發生 HIT 或 SRA 仍呈陽性的患者，Bivalirudin 是美國胸腔醫師學會 (ACCP) 指引首選推薦的術中抗凝血藥物。

resolvedImages.caption: Brenner 11e Table 63.8: Guidelines for Anticoagulation in Hemodialysis Patients at High Risk for Serious Bleeding.

questions.stem: Fondaparinux is a synthetic pentasaccharide used off-label for HIT. What is the major pharmacokinetic limitation of Fondaparinux in patients with severe renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min)?

options.text: It undergoes rapid hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4, causing drug interactions.
It directly cross-links FcγRIIa receptors in 100% of patients with HIT.
It is eliminated primarily by the kidneys and accumulates, increasing bleeding risk in renal failure.
It cannot inhibit Factor Xa in the presence of low antithrombin levels.

questions.sourceExplanation: Fondaparinux 是一種合成的 Pentasaccharide，可選擇性結合 Antithrombin 並抑制 Factor Xa。雖然 Fondaparinux 幾乎不與 HIT 抗體發生 Cross-Reactivity，但其主要經由腎臟排泄，半衰期長達 17–21 小時。在重度腎功能不全 (CrCl <30 mL/min) 或 End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) 患者體內，Fondaparinux 會顯著蓄積並增加嚴重出血風險，因此此類患者禁忌或不宜使用。

resolvedImages.caption: Brenner 11e Table 63.8: Guidelines for Anticoagulation in Hemodialysis Patients at High Risk for Serious Bleeding.

questions.stem: In a patient undergoing maintenance hemodialysis who develops acute HIT, what is the recommended circuit anticoagulation strategy to maintain dialyzer patency without heparin?

options.text: Low-dose Unfractionated Heparin flushes into the arterial line.
Heparin-coated hemodialysis membranes.
High-dose Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin in the venous bloodline.
Regional Citrate Anticoagulation (RCA) or saline flushes.

questions.sourceExplanation: 對於洗腎室 (Hemodialysis Unit) 確診或高度懷疑 HIT 的患者，透析迴路 (Dialysis Circuit) 的首選抗凝策略為 Regional Citrate Anticoagulation (RCA) 或無抗凝洗腎 (Saline Flushes)。Regional Citrate 透過在透析器前螯合 Calcium 離子發揮局部抗凝作用，完全不含有任何 Heparin 成分，且不增加全身性出血或血栓風險。使用 Heparin Flushes 或 Heparin-coated Membranes 均為嚴禁項目。

questions.stem: What distinguishes Type 1 HIT from Type 2 HIT regarding pathophysiology and clinical course?

options.text: Type 1 HIT is a transient, non-immune direct heparin effect with mild platelet drop and no thrombosis risk, whereas Type 2 HIT is immune-mediated with high thrombosis risk.
Type 1 HIT is IgG-mediated, whereas Type 2 HIT is IgE-mediated anaphylaxis.
Type 1 HIT requires mandatory Argatroban therapy, whereas Type 2 HIT requires no treatment.
Type 1 HIT occurs exclusively with LMWH, whereas Type 2 HIT occurs exclusively with Fondaparinux.

questions.sourceExplanation: Type 1 HIT 是由 Heparin 直接與 Platelet 結合引發的非免疫性輕微血小板聚集 (Non-immune direct aggregation)，通常在用藥 1–4 天內發生，Platelet 輕微下降且很少 <100,000/μL，無血栓風險且可自行恢復。而 Type 2 HIT 則是抗體介導的重症病變 (Immune-mediated via IgG against PF4-heparin)，伴隨高度血栓風險與顯著 Platelet 驟降，必須立即停用 Heparin 並使用替代抗凝血劑。

questions.stem: A patient receives Unfractionated Heparin during cardiac surgery 60 days ago. Today, he is re-exposed to UFH for DVT prophylaxis and develops abrupt severe thrombocytopenia within 12 hours. What explains this rapid-onset HIT presentation?

options.text: Direct osmotic damage to platelets by hypertonic heparin solutions.
Circulating anti-PF4/heparin IgG antibodies persisted from the prior heparin exposure within the past 100 days.
Anaphylactoid IgE release from mast cells causing instant platelet destruction.
Acute bone marrow aplasia induced by synthetic heparin preservatives.

questions.sourceExplanation: Rapid-onset HIT 通常出現在過去 100 天內（尤其是 30 天內）曾暴露過 Heparin 的患者身上。因為先前暴露誘發的 Anti-PF4/Heparin IgG 循環抗體尚未完全消失，當重新接觸 Heparin 時，抗體會在數小時內 (≤24 hours) 迅速與新形成的 PF4-Heparin Complex 結合並活化 Platelet，引發爆發性的 Rapid-onset HIT。

questions.stem: What is the main monitoring parameter and target range for guiding continuous intravenous Argatroban infusion in acute HIT management?

options.text: Prothrombin Time (PT), targeted to 4.0 to 5.0 times baseline.
Bleeding Time, targeted to >15 minutes.
Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT), targeted to 1.5 to 3.0 times the baseline value.
Serum Creatinine clearance, targeted to >60 mL/min.

questions.sourceExplanation: Argatroban 透過持續靜脈輸注給藥，其療效與安全性的主要監測指標為 Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT)。臨床目標需將 aPTT 控制在患者基期值 (Baseline) 的 1.5 至 3.0 倍（通常為 55–90 秒）。開始輸注或調整劑量後 2–4 小時需抽血確認 aPTT，達標後每日監測即可。

questions.stem: A patient with acute HIT develops necrotic skin lesions at heparin subcutaneous injection sites and dark discoloration of the toes. What pathophysiological event has occurred?

options.text: Direct cytotoxic necrosis caused by bacterial contamination of heparin vials.
Type I IgE-mediated immediate hypersensitivity reaction.
Acute cholesterol atheroembolization secondary to heparin-induced plaque rupture.
Widespread microvascular thrombosis driven by intense thrombin generation and platelet microparticle release.

questions.sourceExplanation: HIT 導致的皮下注射部位壞死 (Heparin-induced Skin Necrosis) 與肢端缺血壞死 (Venous Limb Gangrene / Phlegmasia cerulea dolens)，是極致高凝血狀態下 Microvascular Thrombosis 的典範表現。此現象源於 Anti-PF4/Heparin 免疫複合物引發爆發性的 Platelet Activation、Platelet Microparticle 釋放與 Thrombin 生成，導致微血管床普遍被微血栓堵塞。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a recognized trigger for HIT in End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) patients who are not receiving therapeutic intravenous heparin?

options.text: Routine heparin flushes for central venous hemodialysis catheter lock and maintenance.
Oral Calcium Carbonate phosphate binder therapy.
Subcutaneous Erythropoietin-Stimulating Agent (ESA) injections.
Dialysate bicarbonate concentration of 35 mEq/L.

questions.sourceExplanation: 在末期腎病 (ESRD) 患者中，即便沒有接受全身性 Therapeutic Heparin 治療，僅僅用於中心靜脈透析導管 (Central Venous Catheter) 封管或沖洗的小劑量 Heparin Flushes (Heparin Lock)，也足以誘發 Anti-PF4/Heparin 抗體產生並引發經典的 HIT。因此診斷 HIT 時，必須徹底封殺包含導管 Flush 在內的所有潛在 Heparin 來源。

questions.stem: In a critically ill patient in the ICU with acute HIT and severe acute hepatic failure (Child-Pugh Class C), how should the initial continuous Argatroban infusion rate be adjusted?

options.text: Increase the initial infusion rate to 5.0 μg/kg/min to compensate for liver failure.
Reduce the initial infusion rate significantly (e.g., from 2.0 μg/kg/min down to 0.5 μg/kg/min) and monitor aPTT closely.
Maintain standard dose because Argatroban is cleared by renal hemodialysis.
Switch immediately to therapeutic Warfarin monotherapy.

questions.sourceExplanation: Argatroban 主要經由肝臟代謝 (Hepatic Clearance)。在肝功能正常的患者中，初始劑量為 2.0 μg/kg/min；但在重度肝功能不全 (Child-Pugh Class C)、嚴重淤膽或多器官衰竭 (Shock Liver) 的 ICU 重症患者中，Argatroban 的 Clearance 會大幅下降 4 倍以上。因此初始劑量必須顯著調降至 0.5 μg/kg/min 甚至更低，並嚴密監測 aPTT 防止嚴重出血。

questions.stem: What is the definition of Autoimmune HIT (or Delayed-Onset HIT)?

options.text: HIT triggered exclusively by natural food products containing endogenous heparin sulfates.
HIT caused by autoantibodies targeting Antithrombin III directly.
HIT characterized by heparin-independent platelet-activating antibodies that persist or begin days after heparin discontinuation.
HIT that resolves spontaneously within 2 hours of heparin administration.

questions.sourceExplanation: Autoimmune HIT (包含 Delayed-Onset HIT 與 Spontaneous HIT) 的特徵為患者體內產生的 Anti-PF4 抗體具備「不依賴 Heparin (Heparin-independent)」即可強效活化 Platelet 的能力。臨床上表現為患者在停用 Heparin 數天至數週後，Platelet 仍持續下降或首度出現新發血栓；此類患者通常需要更長時間的非肝素抗凝血劑治療。

resolvedImages.caption: Brenner 11e Table 63.8: Guidelines for Anticoagulation in Hemodialysis Patients at High Risk for Serious Bleeding.

questions.stem: Which Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) have accumulated clinical evidence as safe and effective oral treatment options for stable, non-life-threatening HIT after acute management?

options.text: Warfarin and Phenprocoumon.
Hirudin and Lepirudin.
Streptokinase and Urokinase.
Rivaroxaban and Apixaban.

questions.sourceExplanation: 近年臨床指引（如 ASH 2018/2026 Guidelines）指出，對於病情穩定、非重症且無急迫血栓危險的 HIT 患者，Oral Direct Factor Xa Inhibitors (如 Rivaroxaban 或 Apixaban) 可作為取代 DTI 靜脈輸注的有效口服方案。DOACs 不會像 Warfarin 般引起 Protein C 驟降，因此不會誘發 Skin Necrosis，且無需複雜的 INR 重疊銜接監測。
